name: Dragonslayer
description: Dragonslayers are void elves who trained to specialise their combat techniques against dragons and dragon-like creatures. This strangely specific elite is said to have been created to ensure the void elves' survival throughout the Great Destruction, a war waged by the Ender dragons looking to conquer the dimension a long time ago; it now mostly lives on as a part of void elves' traditions and culture.
